name: Agentcard
description: Virtual Visa cards for AI agents with MCP-native spending controls and per-task budget limits

authentication.instructions: Get your JWT by running: npx agent-cards signup && npx agent-cards login

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List all virtual cards with balances, expiry, and status

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Create a new virtual Visa card with a fixed USD budget

tools.name: get_card_details
tools.description: Get decrypted PAN, CVV, expiry (requires human approval)

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Fast balance check without exposing credentials

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List card transactions with amount, merchant, status, and timestamps

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Show the current plan, card limits, and month's usage

tools.name: send_support_message
tools.description: Send a message in a support thread
